name: Kaocid
description: A 303-style synth played on the XY pad. Tap to generate a phrase. Still being fine-tuned; the official release is coming soon.

params.name: DEC
params.detail: Filter envelope decay on non-accent notes (~200 ms to 2.5 s; accents fixed at ~200 ms)

params.name: ACC
params.detail: Accent amount: louder VCA + resonance Accent Sweep (wapp)
